evals.prompt: Our settings page looks like an admin panel. The source is /workspace/input/settings-page.html. Review the UI and tell me what makes it feel that way, with concrete fixes. Do not change code yet.
evals.expected_output: A UI/UX review that names specific causes in this page (flat label/value rows, dividers, mixed corner radii on buttons, competing actions in the toolbar), proposes concrete changes with values, and stays in review mode without editing code.
assertions: Names at least three specific causes that are visible in settings-page.html, not generic principles
Proposes concrete values or replacements (spacing, type scale, radii, color) for the problems it names

evals.prompt: The dashboard in /workspace/input/dashboard looks like components bolted together from three different apps. Make the visual system coherent. Edit the files in place and tell me what you changed.
evals.expected_output: The dashboard files are edited to share one spacing scale, one type scale, one accent color, and one radius set; the reply names which conflicting values were replaced.
assertions: Edits /workspace/input/dashboard/styles.css so the three metric cards and three panels share one radius set and one accent color
Replaces the mixed spacing and font sizes with a stated scale rather than adding more one-off values
Explains which existing values conflicted and what they became

evals.prompt: We're building a small iOS habit tracker. Design the main screen with one accent color, a consistent spacing scale, and exactly these four states: empty, loading, error, success, each with real copy. Keep it to one core task and at most three features. Write the single-screen design to /workspace/input/habit-tracker/index.html in one file. Do not launch a browser, take screenshots, or install tooling. In your final summary, list the accent color, the spacing scale, the four states, and the three features.
evals.expected_output: A single-screen design for one core task with one accent color, a consistent spacing scale, all four states (empty, loading, error, success) with real copy, and no more than three core features; the final summary lists those choices.
assertions: The summary names one accent color and a spacing scale, and the styles use them
The file and summary include empty, loading, error, and success states with real copy
The screen has one core task and at most three features

evals.prompt: Fix the null pointer exception in /workspace/input/billing.py when an invoice has no line items.
evals.expected_output: A backend fix for the null pointer exception; no UI or visual design guidance.
assertions: Fixes invoice_total to handle a missing or null line_items value
Does not give UI or visual design advice
